# veterinary-clinic-api

A booking API for a veterinary clinic: owners register pets and book appointments with vets.

> Generated by the Autonomous AI Software Engineering Platform (offline provider).
> Review the code before deploying it anywhere that matters.

## Run locally

```bash
python -m venv .venv && . .venv/bin/activate
pip install -e . pytest httpx2 ruff
uvicorn app.main:app --reload
```

Open http://localhost:8000/docs for the interactive OpenAPI UI.

## Database migrations

The schema is owned by Alembic (`migrations/`); the app never creates tables itself.

```bash
alembic upgrade head                              # apply every migration
alembic revision --autogenerate -m "add a column" # after changing app/models.py
alembic downgrade -1                              # roll the last one back
```

`DATABASE_URL` selects the database (SQLite `./app.db` by default). The container runs
`alembic upgrade head` before it starts the server.

## Test

```bash
ruff check . && pytest
```

The suite builds its database with the migrations, and `tests/test_migrations.py` checks
that they upgrade, match the models, and downgrade cleanly. Set `TEST_DATABASE_URL` to run
that check against PostgreSQL too.

## Container

```bash
docker build -t veterinary-clinic-api:local .
docker run --rm -p 8000:8000 veterinary-clinic-api:local
```

## API

| Method | Path | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `GET` | `/healthz` | Liveness probe |
| `GET` | `/owners` | List owners |
| `POST` | `/owners` | Create an owner |
| `GET` | `/owners/{owner_id}` | Get one owner |
| `PATCH` | `/owners/{owner_id}` | Update an owner |
| `DELETE` | `/owners/{owner_id}` | Delete an owner |
| `GET` | `/pets` | List pets |
| `POST` | `/pets` | Create a pet |
| `GET` | `/pets/{pet_id}` | Get one pet |
| `PATCH` | `/pets/{pet_id}` | Update a pet |
| `DELETE` | `/pets/{pet_id}` | Delete a pet |
| `GET` | `/books` | List books |
| `POST` | `/books` | Create a book |
| `GET` | `/books/{book_id}` | Get one book |
| `PATCH` | `/books/{book_id}` | Update a book |
| `DELETE` | `/books/{book_id}` | Delete a book |

## Deployment

* `deploy/k8s/` - Kustomize base (Deployment, Service). Set `DATABASE_URL` through the
  referenced Secret.
* `deploy/terraform/` - AWS ECR + ECS Fargate service. Run `terraform init && terraform
  plan` with your own VPC and subnets; nothing is applied automatically.

See `ARCHITECTURE.md` for components and design decisions.

from datetime import UTC, datetime

from sqlalchemy import DateTime, ForeignKey, Integer, String, Text
from sqlalchemy.orm import Mapped, mapped_column

from app.db import Base


def _utcnow() -> datetime:
    return datetime.now(UTC)


class Owner(Base):
    __tablename__ = "owners"

    id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(Integer, primary_key=True)
    name: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(255), nullable=False)
    description: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(Text, nullable=True)

"""Alembic environment: the models' metadata and DATABASE_URL."""

from logging.config import fileConfig

from alembic import context
from sqlalchemy import create_engine, text

import app.models  # noqa: F401  (registers every table on Base.metadata)
from app.db import DATABASE_URL, Base

config = context.config
if config.config_file_name is not None:
    fileConfig(config.config_file_name, disable_existing_loggers=False)

# Serialises concurrent upgrades (several replicas starting at once) on PostgreSQL.
_LOCK_ID = 4_204_207


def run_migrations_offline() -> None:
    context.configure(url=DATABASE_URL, target_metadata=Base.metadata, literal_binds=True)
    with context.begin_transaction():
        context.run_migrations()


def run_migrations_online() -> None:
    engine = create_engine(DATABASE_URL)
    with engine.connect() as connection:
        postgres = connection.dialect.name == "postgresql"
        if postgres:
            connection.execute(text("SELECT pg_advisory_lock(:id)"), {"id": _LOCK_ID})
            # The lock is held by the session, so it outlives this transaction; ending it
            # here lets Alembic run (and commit) the migrations in a transaction of its own.
            connection.commit()
        context.configure(
            connection=connection,
            target_metadata=Base.metadata,
            render_as_batch=connection.dialect.name == "sqlite",
            compare_type=True,
        )
        with context.begin_transaction():
            context.run_migrations()
        if postgres:
            connection.execute(text("SELECT pg_advisory_unlock(:id)"), {"id": _LOCK_ID})
            connection.commit()
    engine.dispose()


if context.is_offline_mode():
    run_migrations_offline()
else:
    run_migrations_online()

"""The migrations upgrade a fresh database, match the models exactly, and downgrade cleanly.

Runs on SQLite always, and on PostgreSQL too when TEST_DATABASE_URL points at a database that
may be emptied (for example postgresql+psycopg://app:app@localhost:5432/app_test).
"""

import os
from pathlib import Path

import pytest
from alembic import command
from alembic.autogenerate import compare_metadata
from alembic.config import Config
from alembic.runtime.migration import MigrationContext
from sqlalchemy import create_engine, inspect

from app.db import Base

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
POSTGRES_URL = os.getenv("TEST_DATABASE_URL", "")


@pytest.fixture(params=["sqlite", "postgresql"])
def database(
    request: pytest.FixtureRequest, tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> tuple[Config, str]:
    if request.param == "sqlite":
        url = f"sqlite:///{(tmp_path / 'migrations.db').as_posix()}"
    elif POSTGRES_URL:
        url = POSTGRES_URL
    else:
        pytest.skip("set TEST_DATABASE_URL to check the migrations on PostgreSQL")
    monkeypatch.setattr("app.db.DATABASE_URL", url)  # migrations/env.py reads it per run
    config = Config(str(ROOT / "alembic.ini"))
    config.set_main_option("script_location", str(ROOT / "migrations"))
    command.downgrade(config, "base")  # start from nothing, even on a reused database
    return config, url


def test_upgrade_matches_the_models_and_downgrade_removes_everything(
    database: tuple[Config, str],
) -> None:
    config, url = database
    command.upgrade(config, "head")
    engine = create_engine(url)
    try:
        with engine.connect() as connection:
            drift = compare_metadata(MigrationContext.configure(connection), Base.metadata)
        assert drift == [], drift
        command.downgrade(config, "base")
        assert set(inspect(engine).get_table_names()) <= {"alembic_version"}
        command.upgrade(config, "head")
        assert set(Base.metadata.tables) <= set(inspect(engine).get_table_names())
        command.downgrade(config, "base")
    finally:
        engine.dispose()
files.description: Migrations upgrade, match the models and downgrade

    page = client.get("/owners", params={"limit": 2, "offset": 1})

    assert len(page.json()) == 2

from typing import Any

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

PAYLOAD = {
    "name": "example name",
    "description": "Some longer description text.",
}
OWNER = {
    "name": "example name",
    "description": "Some longer description text.",
}


def _make_owner(client: TestClient) -> dict[str, Any]:
    response = client.post("/owners", json=OWNER)
    assert response.status_code == 201, response.text
    created: dict[str, Any] = response.json()
    return created


def _payload(client: TestClient) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        **PAYLOAD,
        "owner_id": _make_owner(client)["id"],
    }


def test_create_and_get_pet(client: TestClient) -> None:
    payload = _payload(client)
    response = client.post("/pets", json=payload)
    assert response.status_code == 201, response.text
    created = response.json()
    assert created["name"] == "example name"
    assert created["description"] == "Some longer description text."
    assert created["owner_id"] == payload["owner_id"]
    fetched = client.get(f"/pets/{created['id']}")
    assert fetched.status_code == 200
    assert fetched.json()["id"] == created["id"]


def test_list_pet_supports_pagination(client: TestClient) -> None:
    for _ in range(3):
        assert client.post("/pets", json=_payload(client)).status_code == 201
    page = client.get("/pets", params={"limit": 2, "offset": 1})
    assert page.status_code == 200
    assert len(page.json()) == 2


def test_update_pet(client: TestClient) -> None:
    created = client.post("/pets", json=_payload(client)).json()
    response = client.patch(f"/pets/{created['id']}", json={"name": "updated name"})
    assert response.status_code == 200
    assert response.json()["name"] == "updated name"


def test_delete_pet(client: TestClient) -> None:
    created = client.post("/pets", json=_payload(client)).json()

    assert client.get(f"/pets/{created['id']}").status_code == 404

    assert response.status_code == 422


def test_pet_requires_an_existing_owner(client: TestClient) -> None:
    payload = {**_payload(client), "owner_id": 999999}
    response = client.post("/pets", json=payload)
    assert response.status_code == 422
    assert response.json()["detail"] == "Owner 999999 not found"


def test_pets_can_be_filtered_by_owner(client: TestClient) -> None:
    mine = _payload(client)
    assert client.post("/pets", json=mine).status_code == 201
    assert client.post("/pets", json=_payload(client)).status_code == 201
    page = client.get("/pets", params={"owner_id": mine["owner_id"]})

FROM python:3.12-slim AS build
ENV PIP_NO_CACHE_DIR=1 PIP_DISABLE_PIP_VERSION_CHECK=1
WORKDIR /src
RUN python -m venv /opt/venv
ENV PATH=/opt/venv/bin:$PATH
COPY pyproject.toml README.md ./

FROM python:3.12-slim AS runtime

COPY --from=build /opt/venv /opt/venv
WORKDIR /home/app
COPY alembic.ini ./
COPY migrations ./migrations
USER 10001
EXPOSE 8000
HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=3s --start-period=10s --retries=3 \
  CMD ["python", "-c", "import urllib.request; urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:8000/healthz', timeout=3)"]
# Migrations first (a PostgreSQL advisory lock makes replicas that start together apply
# them once), then the server replaces the shell as PID 1.

name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:17-alpine
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: app
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: app
          POSTGRES_DB: app_test
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "pg_isready -U app -d app_test"
          --health-interval 5s --health-timeout 3s --health-retries 10
    env:
      # tests/test_migrations.py checks the migrations on this PostgreSQL as well as SQLite.
      TEST_DATABASE_URL: postgresql+psycopg://app:app@localhost:5432/app_test
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v7
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
          cache: pip
      - name: Install
        run: pip install -e . pytest httpx2 ruff
      - name: Lint
        run: ruff check .
      - name: Test
        run: pytest -q

  image:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: test
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v4
      - name: Build image
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v7
        with:
          context: .
          push: false
          tags: veterinary-clinic-api:${{ github.sha }}
files.description: Lint, type check, test and image build on every push

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: veterinary-clinic-api
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: veterinary-clinic-api
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: veterinary-clinic-api
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: veterinary-clinic-api
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: api
          image: veterinary-clinic-api:latest
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          ports:
            - name: http
              containerPort: 8000
          env:
            - name: DATABASE_URL
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: veterinary-clinic-api-database
                  key: url
                  optional: true
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /healthz
              port: http
            periodSeconds: 10
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /healthz
              port: http
            initialDelaySeconds: 10
            periodSeconds: 20
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 128Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 500m
              memory: 256Mi
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: [ALL]
